titles.title: OllamaProvider: stream creation and stream iteration failures are raised as ModelCallFailedError with the client error as cause
OllamaProvider: completeStructured failures on the call and during iteration are raised as ModelCallFailedError
OllamaProvider: complete() raises a connection refused and a socket hang up (after its retry) as ModelCallFailedError
retry helper: a ModelCallFailedError on the last attempt is re-thrown as a ModelCallFailedError with the attempt prefix
retry helper: a shape failure on the last attempt stays a plain Error even after an earlier failed call
OllamaProvider: a cancelled call (AbortError) reaches the caller as it was raised, on the call and during iteration, and is not taken for a failed model call
retry helper: a cancelled attempt (AbortError) ends the helper at once and is re-thrown as it was raised, not retried and not reported as a failure of shape

OllamaProvider (ISSUE-fb584b48): a request the server rejected for its content (ResponseError 4xx) reaches the caller as it was raised, with its status, not as a failed model call; a 404 (model not found) and a 5xx stay failed model calls

insrc_analyze_step start on a scope the index does not hold (in no registered repository, or in one with no stored entities), for code and docs, is refused with code 'scope-not-indexed' and the run's message, with no size announced and no state minted
insrc_analyze_step start on an indexed repository is answered; data, infra and generic requests on an unregistered directory are not refused for it
insrc_analyze_step plan on a run whose repository is no longer held by the index is refused with code 'scope-not-indexed' before its lookups run
insrc_analyze_step replies to every scope error with the code and message of the one mapping (scopeErrorMapping); only a repository under index is retryable; any other error is not a scope error
insrc_analyze_step (ISSUE-fb584b48): a 'repo-indexing' refusal is retryable only while the repository is being indexed; one for a repository whose last index failed is not
